name: multica-autopilots
title_zh: 把 Multica 定时任务变成可调试的自动驾驶仪
tagline_zh: 创建、更新、检查、触发、调试 Multica autopilot，一次装齐。定时、webhook。
tagline_en: Create, update, inspect, trigger, and debug Multica autopilots—scheduled, webhook, or manual—all from one skill.
desc_en: Use when creating, updating, inspecting, triggering, or debugging a Multica autopilot (scheduled, webhook, or manual).
why_zh: 不是零散命令拼接，而是围绕 autopilot 生命周期设计的完整操作集。状态检查与触发分离。
why_en: Not a grab-bag of commands—a lifecycle-aware toolkit. Separate inspect from trigger, so debugging stays legible.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Multica autopilot 的 CRUD 与触发/调试，不碰 Multica 的模型训练。
limit_en: Scoped to Multica autopilot CRUD + trigger/debug only. No model training, data pipelines, or external integrations. Requires network access to.
